articles.headline: Quentin Grimes scores 47, forces OT with 10th 3-pointer as Lakers rally past Hornets 118-114
articles.description: — Quentin Grimes scored a career-high 47 points and forced overtime on his 10th 3-pointer with 1.7 seconds left in regulation before the Los Angeles Lakers finished off their ninth consecutive victory, 118-114 over the Charlotte Hornets on Tuesday night.

articles.headline: Brice Sensabaugh scores 40 points and leads huge 4th quarter as Jazz beat Clippers for 2nd win
articles.description: — Brice Sensabaugh scored a season-high 40 points, including 25 in the fourth quarter, and the Utah Jazz beat the Los Angeles Clippers 132-107 on Tuesday night for just their second victory of the season.

articles.description: — Jaden McDaniels hit a go-ahead layup with 2.6 seconds remaining after Minnesota stole a Portland inbounds pass and the Timberwolves rallied to beat the Trail Blazers 106-105...

articles.headline: Cunningham, Jenkins lead surge as Pistons snap Spurs' 12-game winning streak with 105-93 victory
articles.description: — Cade Cunningham scored 27 points, Daniss Jenkins had 21 of his 25 in the second half and the Detroit Pistons snapped San Antonio's 12-game winning streak, toppling the Spurs 105-93 on Tuesday night.

articles.headline: Jalen Brunson converts tiebreaking 4-point play, scores 31 as Knicks win 15th straight over Raptors
articles.description: — Jalen Brunson converted a tiebreaking four-point play with 1:25 left in the fourth quarter, Karl-Anthony Towns had 16 points and 16 rebounds and the New York Knicks beat Toronto 111-102 on Tuesday night, their 15th consecutive win over the Raptors.
